texts.title: PABLO ESCOBAR
texts.wealth: In nineteen eighty-seven, Forbes put Pablo Escobar on its billionaire list. A cocaine trafficker, listed alongside the world's richest people.
texts.social: But in parts of Medellin, there was another picture of him. He paid for homes and football fields. People had reasons to be grateful. That support mattered.
texts.questions: How does someone selling cocaine become powerful enough to challenge a government? And how does he convince some of the people living with that violence to see him as a hero?
texts.close: We're going back to Medellin, before the name took over the story.
texts.ship: I mean, not just a little kilo here, a kilo there, but planeloads, shiploads.
texts.wanted: the most wanted man in the Western Hemisphere
texts.fear: He didn't really invent anything, but he had the gift for organization and instilling fear.
